title: Mark VIII complete-tank execution queue

scope.count_note: Survey record count is not the vehicle BOM; inventory reconciliation establishes definitions and quantity scope.

scheduling_rule: Dependencies require accepted technical outputs; accepted_approximate is usable only within its recorded bounds. Missing critical evidence blocks the affected packet, not independent work. Every milestone also requires the workflow's exit gate.

packets.title: Reconcile the production candidate inventory
packets.deliverable: Convert survey identities and assertions into a configuration-specific modeling ledger.
acceptance: Disposition every survey record as a candidate inclusion, exclusion, nonphysical item, reviewed identity mapping or explicit unresolved case; preserve source IDs.
Separate installed, spare, per-side, per-assembly and set quantities; publish unresolved counts and unquantified commercial inventory gaps.
Record first-100 equipment alternatives, review-queue issues and the initial selected portable-equipment loadout.
packets.progress_note: Generated complete survey triage ledger; thirteen explicit initial configuration decisions; candidates and loadout remain unresolved.

packets.title: Define typed data and interface contracts
packets.deliverable: Specify the authoritative configuration, parameter, definition, occurrence, representation and datum records.
acceptance: Document dimensional units, original notation, evidence status, applicability and uncertainty independently.
Define stable identity mapping, rigid-transform convention, interface ownership and one physical parent per occurrence.
Specify representation switching without duplicate BOM entries, source revision handling and dependency invalidation.
packets.progress_note: Typed records, source checks and named datum/occurrence hierarchy implemented; mating contracts and selectable representations remain.

packets.title: Establish the modular CAD build and regression checks
packets.deliverable: Adapt the proven foundation into a subsystem-oriented full-tank build framework.
acceptance: Preserve the foundation pilot as a passing regression fixture; qualify the installed runtime and relative external links.
Build and reopen a representative nested assembly with nonzero rotations, repeated occurrences and selectable representations.
Demonstrate incremental invalidation, missing-link diagnostics and inventory-driven checks; record initial time and memory measurements.
packets.progress_note: Native subsystem build, caching, source comparisons, export and initial regression checks implemented; further representation/performance qualification remains. Deterministic 18-stage brake-stop replay and selective reuse qualified; compact recovery in CURRENT_WORK.json. Source-camera controls and immutable reuse implemented; historical fitting remains a reviewed source task.

packets.title: Review evidence controlling the first installation layout
packets.deliverable: Make a bounded first research pass on production variants, calibration conflicts and critical interfaces.
acceptance: Record decisions or bounded gaps for production fuel/engine/electrical variants, wheel geometry, ring fit, SH642B and sponson interfaces.
Inspect the exact relevant source pages before promoting values; distinguish retrieved documents from archive leads.
Assign each unresolved item an affected packet, fallback or blocker and next evidence action; do not require all external research to finish.
packets.progress_note: Inspected controlling source sections and corrected upper-width/cooling-layout assumptions; remaining interface conflicts documented.

packets.title: Establish the multi-view datum skeleton
packets.deliverable: Create longitudinal geometry, cross-sections and named vehicle and subsystem frames.
acceptance: Retain X-forward, Y-port, Z-up coordinates and the ground datum under the rear drive axle.
Record source/calibration provenance for the envelope, wheel axes, plate planes, compartments and hinge/mount frames.
Preserve independent residuals; treat perspective photographs as observational references unless a justified local-plane measurement is established.
packets.progress_note: Initial longitudinal skeleton, wheel axes and independently specified transverse widths implemented; refined cross-sections remain.

packets.title: Install layout representations of every major system

acceptance: Place hull, running gear, sponsons, powerplant, drivetrain, cooling, fuel, electrical, crew and selected stowage representations.
Identify major interface and clearance conflicts and establish mounting, connection and access datums.
Publish M1 native assembly, sections, envelope uncertainty and coverage report; layout proxies remain distinguishable from finished parts.
packets.progress_note: Initial major-system native layout built; missing equipment and station families remain explicitly listed.

packets.title: Build complete hull panels and primary track-frame structure

acceptance: Model complete plate outlines and component-specific thicknesses, main frame members, principal openings and support extents.
Validate joints, laps, compartments, mounting datums and running-gear clearances.
Replace or explicitly retire pilot coupons; no coupon counts as a finished full-length historical member.
packets.progress_note: 77 individual standard hull plates across 63 source identities replace central/track-frame reference solids. Includes sides, skirts, floors, roof, split closed doors and service leaves. Source counts and nominal plate interfaces checked; curved outlines, braces/angles, bulkheads, chutes, remaining roof/floor covers and fittings still open. See packets/H01.md.

acceptance: Resolve production panel selection and document approximate transverse geometry and hidden construction.

packets.progress_note: Qualified partial drive-shaft/bearing stage:56 new physical occurrences complete both seven-leaf shaft BOMs and separately populate23 bearing/attachment leaves per side. Exact cast profiles, threads, sealing, extra M1552 rivets and engagement remain unresolved. Next: chain drive and remaining running-gear interfaces, then continuing exterior/interior systems. Isolated chain/casing studies now contain all12 selected named SNL casing marks (42 components,300 selected casing occurrences) in an809-leaf native fixture. Corrected packing location follows HB185; register/beading/support geometry passes native fit, receiving-hole/seating and existing hull checks. Quantity/identity conflicts and inferred support bolt allocations remain explicit. A further809-leaf detail candidate forms100cotters and drills400oil passages in200bars;274new material pairs,100cotter capture checks,100pin retention checks,400oil paths and200orientation checks pass, with negative controls and five inspected native rasters. Passage dimensions and tail form remain inferred. Transmission interfaces, source reconciliation, lubrication performance and full-model integration/parameter qualification remain. Original29-stage/17-trial/37-test qualification retained; fresh main-path verification of20 native documents and5341 placements passes. Transfer receipt explicitly distinguishes reused full qualification from new native checks. Opaque, transparent-hull and pinion detail snapshots preserved. Remaining chain/transmission integration and historical fit remain open. The chain fixture now adds two M289 output shafts and two M292 brake drums. Bearings, shaft rings, brake bands and planet-disk connections remain. The latest isolated output-shaft candidate has 825 valid leaves: 12 new sleeve/dowel/ring parts, 26 material pairs without overlap, four journal, four dowel and four ring checks pass; four retained spline fits independently rechecked with zero material change in their engagement regions. Three actual rasters inspected. SNL poured-babbitt lining, HB brasses/shims and M391 foot quantity conflict recorded for fixed-support work. Main standard remains milestone011.
packets.lower_support_experiment_status: 34 angles and 76 bolts built in a separate native document; 1502 candidate pairs without overlap, 348 pin/washer and 76 bolt bearing contacts, all 34 hull seats; headless native reopen and printed-length/negative-contact checks pass.
